answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 104 identities means 104 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the dawn pair is tracked in the lagoon ledger, the ocean audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 28%. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
